ModMetaData.name: Canopy Ghost: See Pawns Under Trees
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
When trees are drawn over pawns (for example with Better Trees' "Render trees over colonists"), pawns and items under a canopy are shown as a translucent ghost through the leaves. Trees stay as they are; nothing switches on or off.
Notes - Only trees drawn above pawns count; with vanilla tree layering this mod does nothing. - Opacity, animals and items can be set in the mod settings. - Optional: hide Better Trees' cursor-transparency button (its hotkey keeps working). - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
